notes.title: Grandiose 4.18
notes.content:
Hello, after a long time dedicated to my other and future project Sunlight Soccer, I am back here with a radical update on Grandiose. It makes major changes to the game, and a great simplification of certain parts. This is to facilitate access to the game, which is currently too complex and elaborate, sometimes unnecessarily. Some parts were imagined before the game looked like anything and so I took a lot of perspective on that.

This update aims to make the game simpler, more fun, and more intuitive, I would like to refocus the game on online fun and strategy. I plan to continue working on the strategic aspect, to make it the major aspect of the game.

- Suppression of thirst, and therefore of the water purifier and drinking water.
- Removed 25 steps from the tutorial.
- Removed the crafting table
- Removal of the toolbox.
- Merger of build and toolbox menus
- Removed island menu
- Removed mineral powder, concrete and ties resources, as well as Cloth.
- Removed the friend tent.
- Removal of detached doors and windows; they are attached to their walls.
- Removed ties and foliage resources for a single thread resource.
- Removal of the stamina.
- Removal of the botanical table
- Removal of traps
- Trees and vegetation are removed from the craft. They are accessible by harvesting a seed that you have planted.
- Fixed a bug on object destruction
- Mechanical devices make less noise.
- New introduction to starting the game, taken from the symphonic poem Heldenlied, by Antonin Dvorak.

notes.title: Grandiose 4.13
notes.content:
The Grandiose 4.13 update brings a lot of fixes to Online and the game in general.


The generator was malfunctioning for the client player in Online.
The display of the Save button for formats that differed from 16:9 has been fixed.
The interaction system has been revamped and optimized.
The stuff saver is usable again.
An issue with parenting cues on the lamp causing the sound not to fade has been fixed.
Plant health display has been fixed.
A display issue on the botany table has been fixed.
An issue preventing plants from spawning has been fixed.
You can now turn lights on and off.
A sound bug causing the widget opening sound to play too loudly on the Botany table has been fixed.
An issue with fly replication has been fixed.
An issue preventing the client player from harvesting flies has been fixed.
It is now possible to pet goats from a client computer.
An issue that caused the pickaxe to appear as the hoe and vice versa has been fixed.
A problem preventing the passage to the seed production stage has been fixed.
A display bug on the plant interface has been fixed.

notes.title: Grandiose 4.12 ONLINE
notes.content:
A new key update in game progress! This update fixes major problems and lays the first brick of a new system that will completely change its gameplay through a major new feature! Here are the new features and corrections of this update!


Complete internal overhaul of the plant system, this one has been modified with a view to adding a new feature which should arrive soon! Almost no difference in gameplay yet.
Changed the breeding system of goats, they no longer need a reproductive fruit, but choose themselves when they reproduce, and reproduce faster when fed or in better health.
Online is finally back!
Fixes to minor cue parenting sound issues.
 Corrections on interface problems and poorly adapted font sizes.

notes.title: Grandiose 4.5
notes.content:
Here is Grandiose 4.5! The update making online available under Unreal Engine 5! I took the opportunity to correct certain problems and to accede to certain requests.


A problem on an interface did not allow the build menu to adapt to different screen sizes.

Some could not have a save during certain parts of the game, this is no longer the case.

Thank you for bringing Grandiose to life! Write a review to testify if you liked the game!

notes.title: Grandiose 4.4
notes.content:
I still made new changes and new fixes to the game, Grandiose is absolutely not abandoned, as long as it continues to be profitable for me, I will continue to work on it, and things don't seem to slow down !


Dramatically slowing down the game clock, giving them more time to acclimate to the game before dark.
A change in the bed code allows the player to advance further in time to go directly from dusk to dawn.
Motion blur can be adjusted in the game's graphics settings.
The game is now compatible with screens with a ratio other than 16/9.
A language selection menu has been added at the start of the game.

notes.title: Grandiose 4.3
notes.content:
Good morning ! I started to integrate some changes to the game!

A bug in the location of the tutorial index variable could cause the tutorial to disappear for some players, simply restart a new island and the tutorial will appear!
The operation of indirect light has been modified, integrating more indirect light to see better in the shadows!
 The flashlight has had its range increased, and has been attached to the camera!
 A modification of the session system prevents the destruction of a session being undoubtedly responsible for the failure of connection among the players!


Problems continue to be solved, several things are to come at the level of the tutorial, to facilitate its use, at the level of the change of language to be able to propose it at the beginning of the game and other things! Thank you for following the game and its development!

notes.title: Grandiose 3.7.0
notes.content:
Hello! 

I will again try to make devblogs and summarize here in an explicit way the progress of the game! I changed the architecture of some crucial systems, allowing me to mod them more easily! Here are the fixes made to the game!


 Fixes added to the sound part of the game, some sound elements were not hosted by the soundclasses supposed to do so and therefore did not react to a change in sound level
 The tutorial was restarting from zero when the player died, if the player had not saved, it is now the case.
 The tutorial was starting from zero when restarting on a new island, some players found this annoying, it will resume at the same step if the player was running the tutorial, and will not run if the player has completed it.
 Added new tutorial steps, earlier explaining how to feed, make hay, fabric, make a bed, and sleep.
 Reduction in overall brightness from 1.2 to 1.1
 Goats have progressive rotations in their movements and a smaller size.
 Sleep is available at any time of the day and corresponds to an advance of 8 hours.
 A Goat got stuck on a talon and couldn't jump out.

notes.title: Grandiose 2.0
notes.content:
Grandiose Update 2.0

 This update is and will likely remain the most significant update in Grandiose gaming history.  It is colossal, compared to the work it must have taken to complete it.  This update puts an end to a lot of the game's flaws. It was therefore crucial.  It took 3 months of hard work and several hundred hours of work to finish it.  Some of you know this but I was the victim of a corrupted data problem and a mess that caused me to lose part of the game. This part has little impact on the player, because in the end for you  it will be the same, but in my case i had to work hard to rebuild this part of the game.

 This loss concerns the player's interface, the one he uses when he is in play. And especially the game instance, it is a large storage place for very important variables for the collapse of the game, it is  kind of a game's information kernel. Fortunately, I had gotten into the habit of using the main character as an information kernel, but the game instance was still important.  It therefore regrouped several databases, for example the database of the crafting table, which contained all the characteristics of the objects, their costs and their name.  There was also the plantation database with the characteristics of the plants, which are numerous.  But the game instance also contained a good deal of reference variables, which allowed several players in the game to exchange values ​​without a direct connection.  So I had to reconstruct this game instance with the other players in the game, and the pieces of programs that showed the presence of certain variables, that helped me a lot.  I also rebuilt the database information, with the game containing information directly visible from the user interfaces.

 Having said that, I took the opportunity to review most of the game, which has changed dramatically.  Here are the changes

 Main additions

 - New interfaces
 - New energy system, including, instead of the solar panel, a generator, a fuel drill.  Several items now run on fuel.
 - Changed the physics of the game.
 - Guide
 - New digital focus of the game

 Changes and additions

 - The barrier has been modified, it is now freely placed, lower and more rustic.
 - The roof safety guardrail has been changed, it is more adapted to the earth and can be used as delimiting a vegetable garden.
 - The soil used on the foundations and as a ceiling has been changed, it has a more tropical texture more in line with the woods of trees present on the island.
 - The ceiling lamp has been changed to a more beautiful and wooden lamp
 - The structures of the house have been decorated with wood on the contours of the doors and windows
 - The window has been changed to match the contours of the windows.
 - Several preview assets have been modified to be more explicit about the position of the future placed object.
 - A door has also been added to the rampart, it slides vertically to open and close.
 - All interfaces have been completely redone.  I changed the font, the design of the backgrounds, I changed the interface sounds.  The design of the buttons, the structure of all the menus, of all the icons.  I also added some background blur.  The construction of the interfaces has therefore been completely redone!
 - The main interface has also seen a change first in its design and then in its operation.  Since it was gone, I decided to rebuild it differently.  The main shape is the same, but the icons, the design of some progress bars have been changed.
 - The operation of the main interface has also been changed.  The interface extension is now maintained when released. This allows the integration of the next new feature.
 - A guide has been added to the interface extension.  It is made up of 9 axes of the game. The basics, providing for oneself, collecting resources, building, plants, animals, energy, Defense, the environment.
 - An indicator has been added above items supplied with fuel or energy that will turn on or off depending on the stock.
 - Changed the player's physics, size and speed, he went from 600 walking speed to 400. And from 1000 sprinting speed to 600.
 - The animals are much smaller than before, this helps to avoid their collision problems.
 - Explanatory guides have been added to the interfaces of several elements of the game.
 - Several systems now benefit from interfaces, for better management, the material drilling machine, the fuel drilling machine, the electric generator.
 - An outdoor light has been added, it has a longer range.
 - Changed start-up operation of the game. The game starts without going through a menu.

 I solved a lot of problems, but I didn't write everything down!  But I fixed the lag and crash issue, definitely.

 The online will be available soon.
